name: v0 iOS App
desc: iPhone app for building and editing v0 projects away from the desk.
desc_zh: 在 iPhone 上创建和修改 v0 项目的应用。
solves: The builder only existed in a browser tab on a computer; the same projects open on the phone with a skills picker and attachments.
solves_zh: 构建器过去只在电脑的浏览器标签里；同样的项目能在手机上打开，带技能选择器和附件。
best_for: You want to tweak a generated app while commuting and share the link from your phone.
best_for_zh: 想在通勤路上改一版生成好的应用，并用手机直接发链接。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — v0.app/changelog directory; A — Apple App Store developer-tools listing）。 Separate surface from v0 on the web, which the ledger already holds. Sign in with Apple arrived 2025-11-18. Apple's iTunes metadata service (itunes.apple.com/search?term=v0%20vercel&entity=software&limit=5&country=us) also returns releaseDate 2025-10-23T07:00:00Z for trackId 6745097949 by Vercel, Inc, but its field order changes between calls, so it is cited as the second source rather than as a verbatim quote. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：形态枚举没有手机应用；账本里手机应用记为 web。 首次公开日期来源：https://v0.app/changelog
